feat(ranking): Card P3.1 capability derivation

Add src/ranking/capabilities.mjs: deriveCapabilities(modelCard, {metrics,
ratings, now}) -> capabilities per design doc 4.1/6.1. Every scored
dimension (tool_use/reasoning/coding) carries a basis tag (card, heuristic,
ratings, prior); reasoning/coding never claim basis card since no provider
card declares reasoning or coding quality. Reuses empirical.mjs modelStats()
for the ratings-vs-prior split and local-failover.mjs isLocalUrl() for
sovereignty tiering, per the card's reuse instruction.
